hypotheses.construction_plan: Let G(t)=polygamma(0,t). The first term is G(t) specialized to t=z. The second term is the derivative of G(t) with respect to t, specialized to t=z.
hypotheses.rationale: The two terms are consecutive orders of the polygamma function; polygamma(1,z) is the derivative of polygamma(0,z), so both arise from one differentiable template G(t) by identity and first derivative specialization.
